verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a robotics framework with CLI tooling, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no feature for applying one operation to many items at once. The launch system coordinates multiple nodes and the sros2 keystore enables security for all participants, but these are adjacent orchestration and security features, not a bulk-operation capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
